_comment: Baseline for dhx-gsd-secret-guard-watch.sh. The GSD secret-read guard is third-party code, vendored by /gsd:update, registered in the live settings.json (NOT the dhx plugin manifest), and it is the ONLY thing covering the secret-file class on the Bash path. Nothing else watches whether it still exists, is still registered, or still carries these bytes. Update this file deliberately, after re-running the behavioural probe against the new guard -- never to silence a warning.
agrees_with: scripts/vendor-dhx-key-read-guard.py EXPECT_SHA -- same bytes, but that assertion runs only at vendoring time, which is provenance of the copy, not liveness of the original
